# Black Silver Holdings

> Black Silver Holdings is a diversified holding company with divisions spanning technology, health, labs, real estate, payroll, wealth management and insurance.

Site: https://blacksilverholdings-demo.pages.dev/
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@BlackSilverHoldings

## Divisions
- [Black Silver Technologies](https://thetechofblacksilver.futuristic-site.workers.dev): Live. Technology and intelligence platforms, including water intelligence.
- [Black Silver Labs](https://blacksilverlabs.pages.dev): Live. A creative studio that builds custom websites, apps, games and videos, with a library of ready-made designs tailored to each client.
- [Black Silver Health](https://blacksilverholdings-demo.pages.dev/health.html): Under construction.
- [Black Silver Real Estate](https://blacksilverholdings-demo.pages.dev/real-estate.html): Under construction.
- [Black Silver Payroll](https://blacksilverholdings-demo.pages.dev/payroll.html): Under construction.
- [Black Silver Wealth Management](https://blacksilverholdings-demo.pages.dev/wealth-management.html): Under construction.
- [Black Silver Insurance](https://blacksilverholdings-demo.pages.dev/insurance.html): Under construction.

## Partners
- [Eco-Urban Designs](https://eco-urbandesigns.com/): A design-build firm delivering cost-effective, buildable sustainable design solutions that combine architecture, engineering and general contracting expertise.

- [Invest](https://blacksilverholdings-demo.pages.dev/invest.html): Under construction.
